required_payload_content: Declare k, a, ell, recombination epoch, sound-horizon, spectrum-role, and readout basis conventions before any peak comparison.
Supply the endpoint-blind effective-potential input used by the acoustic driving term.
Supply endpoint-blind source amplitude normalization compatible with the density role.
Supply a reduced oscillator response kernel or rule translating S_tau_ac into phase and envelope predictions.
Supply coupling sign and normalization relative to baryon loading.
Map operator output to predicted ell, predicted D_ell value, and uncertainty rows without reading endpoint residuals.
Supply finite prediction uncertainty or accepted null-response control under the same domain and convention.
Keep score entry closed until all operator payload rows are accepted.
